We conduct a user study on summarized answers generated from state-of-the-art models and our newly proposed extract-and-decontextualize approach.
We find a large proportion of long-form answers (over 90%) in the ELI5 domain can be adequately summarized by at least one system, while complex and implicit answers are challenging to compress.
To promote future work, we provide an extractive summarization dataset covering 1K long-form answers and our user study annotations.
